fm.title: Requirements authoring
fm.description: Author, organize, and trace formal requirements inside a model (2 blocks)

rows.intent: Author and manage formal requirements directly in the model as a table of preconditions, postconditions, and assumptions — use to capture logical/textual requirements, generate test assessments, and link requirements to design for verification.
Display the requirements linked to the current model or subsystem inside the diagram — use to surface traceability information where the design lives.
